visual_goal: Show plateaus as whole estates at points in time, separated by gaps that work packages close, with scaffolding inside plateaus and a decision register that can revise the target and later plateau.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape of four flat mesas rising like steps, separated by three gaps: a low mesa at the far left labeled 'Baseline', a higher mesa labeled 'Plateau 1', a higher mesa labeled 'Plateau 2', and the highest mesa at the far right, drawn with a dashed hazy outline, labeled 'Target'. Each gap is being bridged by a small crew of unlabeled workers laying planks, with a small sign at each bridge labeled 'Work packages'. On top of 'Plateau 1' and 'Plateau 2' stands a small scaffolding tower with a tiny calendar tag; the one on 'Plateau 1' is labeled 'Scaffolding'. Floating in the sky above the gap between 'Plateau 2' and 'Target', an open book labeled 'Decision register' with exactly two short dashed orange arrows pointing down: one into 'Plateau 2' and one into 'Target'. The left half of the sky above 'Baseline' and 'Plateau 1' is clear and empty.
alt: Stepped mesas from Baseline to Plateau 1, Plateau 2 and a hazy Target, with work-package bridges across the gaps, scaffolding with removal dates on the plateaus, and a decision register that may revise Plateau 2 and the target.

visual_goal: Show Keystone's route through two plateaus with the 2027 Q4 decision forking the internal shape of Plateau 2 into route A or B, both arriving at the same plateau.
prompt: A left-to-right road map illustration. At the far left a station labeled 'Baseline 2027'. A road runs right to a flat platform labeled 'Plateau 1 FY2027'. The road continues past a row of small flag waypoints labeled once '2028 waypoints'. Then a large flat platform labeled 'Plateau 2 FY2029', and finally at the far right a hazy hilltop labeled 'Target 2031'. Above the road between 'Plateau 1 FY2027' and 'Plateau 2 FY2029', a signpost with a fork labeled '2027 Q4 decision' splits a second road into two branches labeled 'Route A' and 'Route B'; both branches curve down and join into 'Plateau 2 FY2029' at the same gate. One thin dashed arrow from 'Plateau 1 FY2027' up to the signpost, labeled 'informs'.
alt: A road from Baseline 2027 through Plateau 1 and 2028 waypoints to Plateau 2 and Target 2031, with the 2027 Q4 decision forking into Route A and Route B that both rejoin at the same Plateau 2 gate.

visual_goal: Show the critical path from the 2027 Q4 decision through the volume proof, posting rules and the 1 January 2029 chart go-live to the merchant subledger migration and Plateau 2, with the year-start go-live amplifying a slip.
prompt: A left-to-right chain of six large stepping stones along a bold orange path: '2027 Q4 decision', 'Volume proof', 'Posting rules', '1 Jan 2029 CoA v2', 'Subledger migration', 'Plateau 2 exit'. One arrow between each consecutive pair, five arrows along the path. The stone '1 Jan 2029 CoA v2' sits in front of a large wall calendar page, emphasizing that it can only happen at a year start. Below the main path, two smaller grey side paths join in with one arrow each: a stone 'FI-CA invoicing' joining into 'Subledger migration', and a stone 'Payout service' joining into 'Plateau 2 exit'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: A critical path of stepping stones from the 2027 Q4 decision through volume proof, posting rules and the 1 January 2029 CoA v2 go-live to the subledger migration and Plateau 2 exit, with side paths from FI-CA invoicing and the payout service.

visual_goal: Show a roadmap organized by plateau rather than project, with milestones on period boundaries and later exploratory bars visibly marked as exploratory.
prompt: A clean horizontal roadmap chart. One single time axis at the bottom with five equal year segments labeled '2027', '2028', '2029', '2030', '2031', and thin vertical grid lines at each year boundary running up through the whole chart. Four horizontal swim lanes stacked top to bottom, labeled at the left 'Plateau 1', 'Waypoints 2028', 'Plateau 2', 'Target'; the lanes are plain rectangles. Plateau 1 lane: three solid blue bars within 2027, then a blue diamond labeled 'Convergence decision' exactly on the 2027 to 2028 grid line. Waypoints 2028 lane: three solid teal bars within 2028, then a teal diamond labeled 'Five day close' exactly on the 2028 to 2029 grid line. Plateau 2 lane: a green diamond labeled 'CoA v2 live' exactly on the 2028 to 2029 grid line, two solid green bars across 2029, and one long green bar across 2030. Target lane: two hatched pale orange bars with dashed outlines, stacked one above the other, both spanning 2030 and 2031, each labeled 'exploratory', and an orange diamond labeled 'Three day close' exactly on the 2030 to 2031 grid line.
alt: A roadmap in four plateau bands from 2027 to 2031, with milestones such as the convergence decision, five-day close, CoA v2 go-live and three-day close sitting on year boundaries, and the later target bars drawn hatched and labeled exploratory.
